title: 3BR - Sleeps 10 | Makeup Room + Rooftop, Near DT!
description:
Gather the girls and escape to this stylish three-bedroom apartment, just 8 minutes from downtown Nashville. Whether you’re hitting Broadway’s honky-tonks, brunching in the Gulch, or snapping Insta-worthy pics around town, this chic retreat is the perfect home base.
Designed with comfort and style in mind, the space is filled with cozy touches and modern amenities—ideal for relaxing with your crew after a day (or night!) of Nashville adventures.

The space
The modern and comfy getaway will leave you in awe with its carefully picked amenity list. 

★ LIVING ROOM ★
How lovely yellow is—and it truly is! The moment you step into this apartment, you feel a sense of relief. Only joy, brightness, and happiness will fill your thoughts. It’s time to open a good bottle of wine and let your Nashville vacation begin! Perfect for relaxing and enjoying the company of friends and family.
✔ Comfortable Sofas with Pillows 
✔ Flat-Screen TV 
✔ Coffee Table 
✔ Sofa

★ KITCHEN ★ 
The kitchen area with numerous cooking appliances and spacious countertops. If you want to take a break from the restaurants, then this is the place for you. 
✔ Microwave
✔ Stove
✔ Oven 
✔ Refrigerator/Freezer 
✔ Dishwasher 
✔ Toaster 
✔ Blender
✔ Sink - Hot & Cold Water 
✔ Trays 
✔ Glasses 
✔ Silverware 
✔ Pots & Pans

★BALCONY★
Enjoy the outdoors on your private balcony. Have breakfast, dinner, or just make a cocktail while taking in Nashville’s skyline and beautiful weather. Lots of wonderful memories will be made here.

★ MAKE-UP AREA ★ 
Such a fantastic feature: a whole make-up area for your entire party. You will be amazed! Yes, Nashville looks good on you!

★ 3 BEDROOMS ★ 
The bedroom features a comfortable bed designed to provide you with the perfect resting experience. 
Bedroom 1:
✔ Queen–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (Sleeps 2)
✔ Wardrobe with Hangers and Shelves 

Bedroom 2:
✔ (2) Full–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (1 Bunkbed - Sleeps 4)
✔ Wardrobe with Hangers and Shelves 

Bedroom 3:
✔ (2) Full–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (1 Bunkbed - Sleeps 4)
✔ Wardrobe with Hangers and Shelves 

★ 3 BATHROOMS ★ 
The apartment features a spacious full bathroom stocked with all necessities and essential toiletries, so you don’t need to bring your own. 
✔ Mirrors 
✔ Toilet 
✔ Towels 
✔ Essential Toiletries

Guest access
The apartment is exclusively yours, without interruption for the duration of your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home. 

Other than the already mentioned amenities, our home is also equipped with: 

✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi 
✔ Air Conditioning 
✔ Heating 
✔ Ceiling Fan 
✔ Washer/Dryer (in the unit)
